name: Rescued Hearts
source:
You joined North Ridge Search and Rescue expecting danger, adrenaline, and tough calls. What you didn’t expect: your by-the-book partner who pushes you harder than anyone else.

Long hours, life-or-death stakes and chemistry you can't ignore. Team rules forbid dating, but keeping it professional is getting harder by the day.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Rescued_Hearts]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你加入了北岭搜救队，期待着危险、肾上腺素和艰难的召唤。你没想到的是：你循规蹈矩的合作伙伴比任何人都更努力地督促你。

长时间的工作、生死攸关的赌注以及你无法忽视的化学反应。球队规则禁止约会，但保持专业性却变得越来越困难。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Rescued_Hearts]Choices Wikia[/url]]
